correctness.rationale: All quantifiers are n>=5, labeled wheel K1 join Cn and ambient-distance-preserving injective partial maps. Proof Step 1 converts distance preservation exactly to induced adjacency for the diameter-two wheel. Step 2 counts cyclic path-run subsets with a distinguished-run division and uses complete forest automorphism factors. Step 3 identifies disjoint hub-free and hub-fixing submonoid copies of the cycle partial-graph-automorphism monoid. Steps 4-5 exhaust exceptional cone automorphism multiplicities K2/K3/diamond and the only cross-type overlaps K1/K2/P3, with all b^2|Aut| factors. Step 6 sums the polynomial. Actual standalone verify.py exhaustively enumerated all partial injections for rim lengths 5, 6, 7, reproducing every rank and each exceptional correction; its finite checks corroborate rather than replace proof.

value.rationale: The monoid is a natural infinite family actively studied via Green relations and minimal generating-set ranks. A complete element count at every domain rank, and an exact polynomial census of precisely the noncanonical hub-moving maps, are natural structural invariants not supplied by a generating-set rank. The finite-support correction explains why almost the entire wheel partial-isometry monoid consists of two canonical cycle-induced families, while cleanly isolating the rank-one through rank-four deviations. It supplies exact sizes of every rank ideal and a usable all-n recurrence-free finite sum, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a single finite table.
